# Miami Heat Fantasy Basketball Preview [26/27 NBA Season]

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-10-07, 37:06. https://youtu.be/cvhcheoKdbo

## Summary

Josh Lloyd previews the Miami Heat for the 2026/27 fantasy season now that Giannis Antetokounmpo is on the team. He expects the Heat to move away from last season's very fast, low pick-and-roll scheme. His projected starters are Davion Mitchell, Klay Thompson, Andrew Wiggins, Giannis and Bam Adebayo. He calls Giannis a clear top-5 pick in category leagues and the team's best target. He argues that straight 9-cat rankings undervalue him and that drafting Giannis does not force you to punt categories. He likes Bam around round 3. He is lower on Wiggins and calls Davion Mitchell the biggest fade at his Yahoo rank of 110. He says not to draft Klay Thompson or Tim Hardaway Jr., sees Pelle Larsson only as a late flyer, and names Bobby Portis as the stash pick because the frontcourt depth is thin.
